title: How does Pinnacle Blooms help children with Autism prepare for mainstream school?
metaTitle: Preparation for Mainstream School at Pinnacle Blooms Network
description: Discover how Pinnacle Blooms Network prepares children with Autism for a smoother transition to mainstream schooling, by honing their social, behavioural and communication skills.
html: At Pinnacle Blooms Network, we understand that transitioning to a mainstream school might be a big leap for your child with Autism. Our team of expert therapists curates a comprehensive plan involving therapies like ABA and Speech Therapy to help your child develop necessary social and classroom behaviors and enhance their communication skills. This careful and thoughtful preparation aims to make the transition smoother for your child.
